members.name: CollectParallel
members.summary: Collects all per-thread buffers into the main Shapes array via Array.Copy (unsorted). Resets per-thread counts.

members.name: CollectParallelSorted
members.summary: K-way merge of all per-thread buffers into the main Shapes array, sorted by Z. Each thread's buffer must be pre-sorted via SortBufferByZ. Uses a min-heap for O(N log T) merge.
